sql: SELECT assay.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, target.target_type, target.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, act.standard_type, act.pchembl_value FROM activities AS act INNER JOIN assays AS assay ON act.assay_id = assay.assay_id INNER JOIN target_dictionary AS target ON assay.tid = target.tid INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary AS md ON act.molregno = md.molregno INNER JOIN compound_structures AS cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE target.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1741208' AND act.standard_type = 'IC50' AND act.standard_relation = '=' AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC, assay.chembl_id ASC LIMIT 1000
